description: Live distribution of minted 8004 NONCE pieces across difficulty bands, read from the chain. Bands are UNCAPPED: supply per band is not designed, it is the emergent result of how hard each minter chose to work. Returns raw counts only — no interpretation.

limit.description: Maximum tokens to sample from the start of the collection. Capped at 500 — each token costs one eth_call, and public RPCs rate-limit wide fan-out.
